details.description: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 is Alibaba's July 2025 update to the Qwen3-30B-A3B mixture-of-experts chat model, released as a non-thinking model only: it does not produce visible step-by-step reasoning. It has 30.5B total parameters with 3.3B activated per token across 128 experts (8 active per token). The model card reports 'significant improvements' over the original Qwen3-30B-A3B in instruction following, logical reasoning, mathematics, science, coding and tool usage. Native context is 262,144 tokens, extendable to 1 million tokens with Dual Chunk Attention.
advantages: Scores 78.4 on MMLU-Pro, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 61.3 on AIME25, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 83.8 on MultiPL-E, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Native context window of 262,144 tokens, extendable to 1 million tokens using Dual Chunk Attention, per the model card.
Fully supports function calling, with the model card recommending the Qwen-Agent framework for tool-calling templates and parsers.
disadvantages: Runs in non-thinking mode only; it does not produce visible <think> reasoning traces, per the model card.
use_cases: Instruction following and general-purpose chat without step-by-step reasoning traces
Coding assistance, per the model's MultiPL-E benchmark result
Tool calling and agentic workflows via the Qwen-Agent framework
Long-document and long-context tasks up to 262,144 tokens natively

notes: Catalog's 262,144 max input/output tokens match this model's native context window per its Hugging Face card; the card recommends generating up to 16,384 output tokens for typical instruct tasks, well below the catalog's configured maximum. Fireworks lists serving an FP8-quantized build of this model. Arena-Hard v2 (69.0) is reported on the model card but omitted from evaluations as an arena-style score.
